- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for creating a natural-looking landscape design include:
  1. Emphasizing irregular shapes
  2. Using natural materials
  3. Creating different layers (canopy, understory, groundcovers)
  4. Considering the seasonality of plants
  5. Replicating natural plant communities
